author: Midwinter Minis
description:
My video "I think I'm done with Warhammer 40k" was cited in a Dragoneye financial report. Its release coincided with a short, sharp downturn in Games Workshop's share price. I was then interviewed in The Times, one the UK's national newspapers. Causation, or coincidence? Let's figure it out...

The article in The Times: https://www.thetimes.com/business/companies-markets/article/games-workshop-dragoneye-warhammer-youtube-n28r6sflh
